text:
Emma: Quick draft for a 1-pager we can hand to field for secure/private deployments. Thinking micro-brief structure: 1) Topline value prop, 2) SLA & security snapshot, 3) Benchmark highlights (p95 latency, cost delta vs self-host), 4) Routing / next steps. Draft in Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/secure-brief

Raj: Love that. Can we add a one-line callout for fallback model variants + private VPC options so engineers know we support graceful degradation and on-prem alternatives?

Tia: Who owns the benchmark data? Sales will ask for sources. Also what's our p95 for text-gen-2 on Dedicated at 512 tokens? Need an attributable number.

Owen: From the last run (2026-03-15): text-gen-2 @ 512 tokens p95 = 72ms, median cost per 1k tokens on Dedicated = $0.45. Our self-host median for the same workload was ~$0.70. I'll attach the csv to the Drive link below.

Emma: Perfect. We'll call that out as a quantified delta: ~35% lower unit cost vs typical self-host baseline. I'll craft a one-sentence exec blurb + a 3-bullet ops snippet.

Raj: For the webinar, let's demo live failover and routing rules (show Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private fallback chain). Proposed date Apr 7. Tia — can you own the bench slides? Owen — demo infra?

Tia: I can own benchmarks + live Q&A on model selection. Need ~6 slides and a 10-min demo script. Also please add a FAQ item that covers KMS/HSM and audit logs.

Owen: Demo + infra: yes. Quick sample inbound routing snippet for sales to copy into playbook:

```
# inbound-routing pseudo code
if country == 'US' and compliance == 'high':
    route -> private-vpc
elif enterprise_commitment >= 50000:
    route -> dedicated-sales
else:
    route -> hosted-api
```

Copyable and we can turn into a small flowchart for the one-pager.

Emma: Nice. Marketing deliverables: 1) one-pager PDF (single page, 4 panels), 2) 30s social explainer post + hero graphic, 3) webinar landing page copy. LaunchBot/Marcom can schedule announcement + paid creative.

LaunchBot: Draft landing page created: https://redwood.app/landing/secure-serve. I can schedule the announcement for Apr 7 10:00 PT if Emma confirms final assets by Apr 3 EOD.

Raj: Confirm schedule. Also recommend we run an A/B test on the landing headline: Variant A = "Predictable SLAs for LLM Serving" vs Variant B = "Lower Cost, Reliable Inference at Scale" — measure CTR and gated download conversion.

Tia: Added a short compliance checklist to the draft notes: SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA (where customer needs), plus KMS integration options and audit trail examples. Will include in FAQ.

Emma: I'll assemble the final one-pager by EOD Apr 3. Task list: Emma = copy + exec blurb; Tia = bench slides + FAQ; Owen = demo script + routing snippet; Raj = A/B messaging + webinar flow; LaunchBot = schedule + landing page.

Owen: Uploading benchmark csv and demo script to Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/secure-brief-assets

Emma: Thanks all :rocket: Will post the first PDF draft here when ready for review.
